title: Service Blueprint IR
description: Intermediate representation for a service blueprint, authored as human-editable JSON in the workspace blueprint/ directory and validated by scripts/validate_ir.py (JSON is the supported authoring format; the stdlib scripts read .yaml/.yml only if PyYAML is installed). Mirrors the template data model (see references/data-model.md): service -> phases -> scenarios -> paths -> lanes/steps/cells/triggers. Every entity carries a stable, locale-independent string key; database UUIDs are UUIDv5-derived from the key path (service/phase/scenario/path/lane/step) plus the locale, NFC-normalized, so re-imports are idempotent by construction. Cells are identified by their (path, lane, step) key triple; dependency edges by their source->target cell pair AND their kind, matching the database's uniqueness key (source_cell_id, target_cell_id, kind). Renaming a key after import creates a NEW identity on the next import. ALL human-readable text fields are locale maps ({en: ..., zh: ...}; additional locales allowed); structural fields (keys, enums, orders, URLs) are locale-independent.

schema_version.description: Template schema version this IR was authored against, newest first — the FIRST entry is the version this template speaks, and validate_ir.py refuses any IR not at it, naming the migration. This enum is the ONE list: scripts/validate_ir.py reads it, and src/lib/backend/schemaVersion.ts is asserted against it. Import performs a compatibility check against the workspace clone's schema_version (see skills/map/references/workspace-state.md) and against a live target's public.schema_version (references/adapter-contract.md § 2). ⚠ Every value added here ships its migration step in scripts/migrate_ir.py in the SAME change — consumers hold signed-off data that cannot be re-derived, so a bump with no step is a bump with no answer (references/customization.md § The versioning rule). A version leaves this list when the migration that carries it forward stops existing.

locales.description: Locales this blueprint is authored in. Every localeText field should cover all declared locales; the validator flags gaps. One generated artifact set and one deploy target per locale.

key.description: Stable identifier: lowercase alphanumerics, hyphen, underscore. Locale-independent. Feeds UUIDv5 derivation — treat as permanent once imported.

locale.description: BCP-47-style locale tag, e.g. en, zh, zh-Hant.

localeText.description: Locale -> text map, e.g. {en: 'Submit repair ticket', zh: '提交报修工单'}.

source.description: Source document path or URL this content was extracted from.

section.description: Section heading, page, sheet, or frame within the source.

cellRef.description: Reference to a cell on the same path by its (lane, step) key pair.

type.description: url = external link chip; tech_description = long-form copy attached to a tech pill, keyed by the pill label.

picture.description: Screenshot/illustration path or URL for tech_description links.

pictures.description: Multiple images (e.g. logo + screenshot); takes precedence over picture.

loops_to.description: Key of another phase this phase loops back to (loops_to_phase_id).

view_type.description: single = one path at a time; side-by-side = labeled variant comparison (see paths[].variant_label); integrated = runtime merge of all paths.

steps.description: Scenario-scoped step columns, shared across paths. Per-path column order lives in paths[].path_steps.

note.description: Optional note shown with path metadata (e.g. parallel-scenario context).

variant_label.description: Label for this path as a comparison variant in side-by-side view (e.g. 'as designed' vs 'as actually done'). Any two labeled variants compare — designed-vs-reality is just the default labeling.

path_steps.description: Scenario step keys in column order for THIS path (array index = position). Every cell's step must appear here — the DB trigger aborts imports otherwise.

display_name.description: Free-form swimlane label in any language (lanes.name in the DB).

role.description: Semantic role key (lanes.lane_role) driving rendering and divider lines. Canonical: customer_actions, frontstage_actions, backstage_actions, frontstage_tech, backstage_tech, support_systems, visual, step_visual. Org-defined custom roles and null both render as generic swimlanes. See references/lane-roles.md.

kpis.description: What this lane's actor is measured on (kpi-alignment check reads these).

tools.description: Systems/tools the lane's actor works in (kpi-alignment context).

content.description: Cell label, the primary grid text. Newline-separated items render as pills on pill-role lanes. Omit (or empty strings) for visual-row picture cells.

picture.description: Image path or URL (visual rows and illustrated cells).

needs_review.description: Low-confidence extraction — surface during review; sign-off should clear or confirm these.

evidence.description: Verbatim quotes or pointers backing this cell (researcher traceability). Reserved shape; no v1 UX.

attribution.description: Who asserted this content (stakeholder-merge conflicts modeled as data). Reserved shape; no v1 UX.

function.description: What this cell does for the journey (spec field; audit wave 2 reads it).

form.description: How the cell manifests — channel, artifact, interface (spec field).

owner.description: Recorded owner tag (shared vocabulary — reuse existing tags).

perceived_owner.description: Who the customer BELIEVES owns this moment (perceived-owner check compares the pair).

kind.description: What kind of dependency this edge is. trigger = temporal: the source sets the target in motion, and the canvas draws an arrow. needs = functional: the source requires the target, and the canvas draws nothing — it reads in the cell panel only. ABSENCE MEANS 'trigger': that is the cell_dependencies.kind column default and the meaning every edge authored before 2026.08.26 already carried, so no existing file changes and no authored value moves. The pair alone is no longer an identity — a source->target pair may carry BOTH kinds as two rows, so the UUIDv5 derivation and the duplicate check both read the kind.

trigger.description: Directed dependency edge between two cells on the SAME path (cross-path edges are invalid). source != target, whatever the kind. `kind: trigger` (the default) is the temporal arrow this array is named after; `kind: needs` is the functional dependency the database has stored since cell_dependencies grew the column, and which the IR could not express — and therefore silently dropped on export — until 2026.08.26.
